cases.name: Goblin Trapfinder
cases.text: When this creature dies, seek a creature card with mana value 3 or less. That card perpetually gains haste, "This spell costs {1} less to cast," and "At the beginning of your end step, sacrifice this creature."

cases.name: Neera, Wild Mage
cases.text: Whenever you cast a spell, you may put it on the bottom of its owner's library. If you do, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a nonland card. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. Then put all revealed cards not cast this way on the bottom of your library in a random order. This ability triggers only once each turn.
